title.ko: 역사와 기억: commemorate · in retrospect · be remembered as · bear witness
title.en: history and memory: commemorate, in retrospect, be remembered as, bear witness

explain.ko: 역사와 기억에 관한 글은 사건의 서술, 평가, 교훈으로 구성됩니다. 사건은 과거 시제와 수동태로, 평가는 in retrospect, be remembered as, be regarded as로, 교훈은 It reminds us that ..., We must ...로 표현합니다. commemorate, bear witness, legacy 같은 연어를 활용하고, 해석이 엇갈리는 경우 헤징과 대조(while, whereas)로 균형을 유지하세요. 사실과 해석을 구분해서 쓰는 것이 중요합니다.
explain.en: Writing on history and memory comprises narration, assessment and lesson. Narrate in past tense and passive; assess with in retrospect, be remembered as, be regarded as; draw lessons with It reminds us that ..., We must .... Use collocations such as commemorate, bear witness and legacy, and keep balance with hedging and contrast (while, whereas) where interpretation differs. Distinguish fact from interpretation.

lines.t: History is made of records and memory. Records remain as documents, while memory is passed on through people's stories. Collective memory can sometimes differ from fact, so it must be examined critically.

items.passage:
COLUMN
The politics of memory
Building a monument is a way of remembering the past, but it is also choosing what to remember. Some commemorate heroes, others remember victims. Balanced memory begins by listening to different voices.

trans.ko:

prompt.ko: 한 역사적 사건을 기념·회고·평가·교훈 순으로 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write four sentences on a historical event: commemoration, retrospect, assessment, lesson.

task.model: Every year we commemorate that day and honour the victims. In retrospect, the event was a turning point that changed society greatly. The leader of that era is remembered as a reformer, but opinion is still divided. Facing the past is the starting point of reconciliation.

model_trans.ko: 우리는 매년 그날을 기념하며 희생자를 기립니다. 돌이켜보면 그 사건은 사회가 크게 바뀌는 전환점이었습니다. 그 시대의 지도자는 개혁가로 기억되지만 평가는 여전히 엇갈립니다. 과거를 직시하는 것이 화해의 출발점입니다.
model_trans.en: Every year we commemorate that day and honour the victims. In retrospect, the event was a turning point that changed society greatly. The leader of that era is remembered as a reformer, but opinion is still divided. Facing the past is the starting point of reconciliation.
